item.title: LENS Foundation Opens Nominations for 2025 Isle of Palms Public Safety Awards
item.description: The LENS Foundation (Law Enforcement Neighborhood Support Foundation) is now accepting nominations for the 2025 Isle of Palms Public Safety Awards, which recognize two outstanding members of the Isle of Palms Police and Fire departments.

item.title: Legal Updates for Sullivan's Island
item.description: The South Carolina Court of Appeals has handed down two separate decisions that have the potential to affect both quality of life and property ownership on Sullivan's Island.

item.title: Credit One Charleston Open releases preliminary 2026 player field
item.description: The Credit One Charleston Open, North America’s largest women’s-only professional tennis tournament, has released the preliminary player field for the 2026 event, taking place March 28 - April 5 on Daniel Island in Charleston, South Carolina.

item.title: Island Club to Host Batik Workshop with Artist Arianne Comer
item.description: Island Club members are invited to a special workshop with batik artist Arianne Comer on Saturday, April 25, from 1 to 4 p.m. at the Island Club.

item.title: Charleston Symphony Announces 2026-2027 Season
item.description: The Charleston Symphony Orchestra’s (CSO) 2026-2027 season invites audiences to experience a year defined by storytelling, artistic ambition, and the commanding sound of the orchestra in full force

item.title: City of Isle of Palms Hosts Easter Egg Hunt
item.description: The Easter Egg Hunt is back. On Saturday, April 4, at 10 a.m. sharp, children ages 12 and under will begin a mad dash for eggs at the largest Easter egg hunt this side of the IOP Connector.

item.title: Battery Gadsden to present U-Boat program
item.description: If you happen to visit the Fort Moultrie Visitor Center, you will find as part of its World War II exhibit two mentions of German U-boat incursions into Charleston Harbor during the war in 1942.
